# test

Evaluate a condition and report it through the exit status with MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/test -f input.txt

moonx cli/test 3 -lt 5

moonx cli/test -n value
```

Return 0 for true, 1 for false and a nonzero error status for invalid expressions. Successful evaluation produces no output.

## Common options

| Option | Description |

| `-n VALUE` | True when the string is nonempty. |
| `-z VALUE` | True when the string is empty. |
| `-e VALUE`, `-a VALUE` | Test existence or file type. |
| `-f VALUE` | Test existence or file type. |
| `-d VALUE` | Test existence or file type. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
| `-eq` | Compare integer operands for equality. |
| `-lt` | Compare integer operands using less than. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Supports strings, Int64 integers and available file/access/size/time predicates. Terminal, ownership and unavailable mode/identity queries are unsupported.
- Unary -a is a project alias for file existence.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
